providerQuery._note: capacitor is selectable but the stub reports not-implemented (tests the error path). traceWhenUnset: first trace of the import.meta.glob list (gps-trace-format section 5) that passes validateTrace. Boolean params use '1'/'0' in the URL. `start`, `seed`, `e2eClassId`, `e2eSkipF04App` and `e2eSkipOnboarding` (F04-dungeon-presence.md section 17 test hooks, tech gate P2-F05-T15 decision 6.2, D-130) are read only when `loc=mock`: `start` sets the game clock's replay-start instant (integer epoch ms, or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm` interpreted with `config/balance/dungeons.json#openingHours.utcOffset_min`, read via config/balance.ts); `seed` sets the uint32 RNG `runSeed` for every run started on that page load; `e2eClassId` dispatches a real `chooseClass` input once at boot for a spec that skips the class-picker screen (P2-F06-T10); `e2eSkipF04App` skips creating the whole F04 game loop for a map-only spec; `e2eSkipOnboarding` (P2-F06-T10) makes the onboarding step machine (`apps/client/src/onboarding-flow.ts`) report `done` immediately at boot, for the pre-existing specs that boot straight into the map/run screens and do not themselves test onboarding. All five are silently ignored outside `loc=mock` (Web always uses the real clock and `crypto.getRandomValues`, ADR 0003 section 6) — see `apps/client/src/f04-app.ts`'s `resolveRunSeed`/`resolveE2eClassId`, `apps/client/src/env.ts`'s `shouldSkipF04App`, and `apps/client/src/onboarding-flow.ts`'s own e2e-skip read, each gated on the selected provider, not a build-time flag

toast._note: apps/client/src/ui/tick-toast.ts: tickHoldDurationMs is how long a granted/denied tick toast stays fully visible (after its own vfx enter animation, before the shared exitToast animation starts) — long enough to read a short Thai sentence at a glance per the flow's own 'อ่านจบได้ในแวบเดียว' rule without outlasting the next tick window. tickMaxIconsShown is flow F05 A1's literal cap ('ไม่เกิน 3 ชิ้นที่เห็นพร้อมกัน ที่เหลือดูในสรุป run'). hpLowHoldDurationMs is the same 'stays fully visible before exit' hold, just for `run.hpLow`'s own, much longer canon sentence ('HP ต่ำ กลับบ้าน ซื้อยา หาเพื่อนที่มี Support หรือไม่ก็เลิกดื้อ', a full clause list vs a tick toast's few words) — its own key rather than reusing tickHoldDurationMs so the two can be tuned independently. screenLockNoticeHoldDurationMs (F06 copy gate C6-03, flow F06 Flow E ข้อ E2) is `run.screenLockNotice`'s own auto-fade hold, read by apps/client/src/ui/pocket-screen.ts — it also hides immediately on `dungeon_exited` regardless of this timer.

pocketScreen._source: P2-F06-T14 (design/ux/components.md section 12.1 'ปัดขึ้นค้าง ระยะเวลาขั้นต่ำเป็น implementation ของ gameplay-programmer แต่ต้องนานพอกันปัดผ่านโดยบังเอิญ'). No flow/spec doc gives exact numbers for either the hold duration or the swipe distance.
pocketScreen._note: apps/client/src/ui/pocket-screen.ts#shouldTriggerPocketExit's only two thresholds: the pointer must both move up by at least swipeUpMinDistance_ratio's share of the viewport height AND still be held down once swipeUpHoldMinDuration_ms has elapsed since pointerdown — either alone (a plain long-press with no movement, or a quick flick released early) must not exit the pocket screen (rule 2 of design gate A 4.4's 8 rules). A ratio of the viewport height (resolved to real px by ui/pocket-screen.ts at every pointerdown, D-134's own condition, P2-F06-T20 6.1: not cached once at mount — a resize/orientation change between two gestures on the same run must not leave a stale, wrong-proportion threshold), not a fixed px count, so the threshold scales the same way across a small and a large phone screen (P2-lint: config-lint's 3.10.3 unit table has no _px entry — a viewport-relative _ratio is both config-lint-legal today and the more correct choice for a real range of device screens; tech-lead may still add _px later if a future value genuinely wants absolute pixels).
pocketScreen._assumption: A-P2-F06-T14-2: 600 ms (about 2x the single-pulse vibration length elsewhere in this file) and 0.03 (about 24 px on a ~800 px-tall mobile viewport — a typical single-step drag threshold, clearly more than incidental finger jitter in a pocket) are not tuned against a real device/field-walk pass yet. Owner: gameplay-programmer, revisit with P2-F06-T12/P2-F06-T26 field evidence.

bundle._source: ADR 0003 section 10 (N-13): JS-transfer budgets measured from apps/client/dist's Vite manifest by apps/client/scripts/measure-bundle.ts, brotli quality 11, same method for both keys.
bundle._note: initialJsBudget_bytes covers the entry chunk + every chunk it statically imports (S5 <= 1.0 MB, 10^6 byte) — never maplibre-gl, which main.ts only reaches through await import(...) once hasRuntimeMapEnv(env) is true (P2-F04-T10 code-split). mapLazyJsBudget_bytes covers that lazy maplibre-gl + worker chunk group on its own, measured the same way. CSS/font/tile/trace bytes are excluded from both (ADR 0003 10.4). CI (P2-F06-T16) fails the build when either is exceeded.
bundle._assumption: A-P2-F04-T10-2: this task's own `pnpm build` + `apps/client/scripts/measure-bundle.ts` measured the entry chunk (post code-split) at 48,303 B brotli and the maplibre-gl + worker lazy group at 350,208 B brotli. initialJsBudget_bytes keeps the S5 <= 1.0 MB ceiling from ADR 0003 unchanged (measured value is well under it already); mapLazyJsBudget_bytes is set to 700,000 B (about 2x the measured 350,208 B) for headroom before P2-F06 adds more map layers/assets, not tuned against a real device yet (revisit once P2-C03's real-device numbers land). Owner: gameplay-programmer, tech-lead

requestOrigins._source: config/app/privacy.json#externalNavigation _note ("outside the allowed-origin list of config/app/client.json"); docs/tech/F04-dungeon-presence.md section 14.1 ("e2e ตรวจ origin (C2-1, P2-F04-T22)"); qa/plans/F04-test-plan.md section 6 (C2-1); filled by P2-F06-T08 after P2-F04-T25 missed it (A-P2-F04-T22-2, qa/tests/e2e/f04-origin-allowlist.spec.ts); extended by P2-F06-T10 per tech gate P2-F05-T15 R2-02 (docs/reviews/F04-F05-tech-gate.md section 9.3), closing A-P2-F06-T08-1
requestOrigins._note: Every request/fetch/XHR/WebSocket the app itself may issue must stay within this list. 'self' means the page's own origin. An 'env:<VAR_NAME>' entry resolves to that build-time VITE_* env var's own origin (first-party only, resolved at build — docs/tech/environments.md's own VITE_TILES_URL/VITE_GLYPHS_URL/VITE_SPRITE_URL rows, infra/pages/keep-walking-map/_headers sets CORS for exactly this reason): the deployed map tile/glyph/sprite CDN is a separate origin from the app itself, and tile requests reveal roughly where the player is looking at the map, so it must stay first-party (our own Pages project), never a third-party host. An env entry whose var is unset at build/runtime resolves to nothing (not an error, not 'allow anything') — an e2e/dev build with no map env configured simply never issues that request in the first place (env.ts#hasRuntimeMapEnv). Phase 2 has no server (D-087): telemetry stays in localStorage/memory only, so 'self' still covers every non-map request. The external navigation deep link (Google/Apple Maps, config/app/privacy.json#externalNavigation) is a top-level <a target="_blank"> page navigation the player taps themselves, not a fetch/XHR of the app, and stays explicitly outside this list (tech note F04 14.1). `qa/tests/e2e/f04-origin-allowlist.spec.ts` resolves this list for real (both the 'self' and 'env:' shapes) rather than only ever comparing against the page's own origin; no apps/client/src module parses it at runtime (display/behaviour never depends on it — it exists as the single source this e2e diffs against).
requestOrigins._assumption: A-P2-F06-T08-1 (closed, R2-02): the key shape is 'self' plus zero or more 'env:<VITE_*_URL name>' entries, each resolving to that env var's own origin at build time — never a literal third-party origin string. Confirmed: tech-lead (R2-02, docs/reviews/F04-F05-tech-gate.md section 9.3).
